name: celmis-code
description: Search and read code across your organisation's repositories through a Celmis server: ranked symbol search, outlines, callers, and 'do it like service X' patterns, all with a token budget and no secret values.

celmis_url.title: Celmis server address
celmis_url.description: The address the Connect page of your Celmis web app shows, for example https://celmis.example.com/backend: https, no trailing slash, no /mcp. Only localhost may use http.

celmis_token.title: Celmis token
celmis_token.description: Optional. Leave empty: Claude Code signs you in through your browser the first time it connects (/mcp, then Authenticate). Give a token only for the hints the plugin adds to a session; it is never sent to the server by this plugin. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage, never in a settings file.
